stemMd: Costa's share of all e-bikes sold in Valdoria in 2025 was closest to
instructionsMd: Use only the figures shown. Work by hand.
explanationMd:
Share means Costa's 2025 sales over the national 2025 total. The national total is $50 + 35 + 66 + 24 = 175$ thousand, so

$$\frac{66}{175} \approx 0.377 \approx 38\%$$

**Doing it by hand.** $175 \times 0.4 = 70$, which is 4 more than 66, and 4 is about 2.3 per cent of 175. So the share is about $40 - 2.3 = 37.7$ per cent.

**The trap.** Keep the year consistent in the numerator and the denominator. Costa's 2024 share was $\frac{60}{140} \approx 43$ per cent, and mixing the years produces two more of the listed figures.

distractorRationale.a: This divides Costa's 2024 sales by the 2025 total, $\frac{60}{175} \approx 34$ per cent: numerator and denominator are from different years.
distractorRationale.c: This is Costa's 2024 share, $\frac{60}{140} \approx 43$ per cent. The question asks about 2025, when the other regions grew faster and Costa's share fell.
distractorRationale.d: This divides Costa's 2025 sales by the 2024 total, $\frac{66}{140} \approx 47$ per cent: the years are mixed the other way round.

accessibilityText: A question about the bar chart of e-bike sales by region. It asks what Costa's share of all e-bikes sold in 2025 was closest to. The options are 34 per cent, 38 per cent, 43 per cent and 47 per cent.

provenance.notes: Original item. Each distractor comes from using the wrong year in the numerator, the denominator, or both.

review.author: bocconi-graduate-author

independentSolve.workingNotes: 2025 total = 50+35+66+24 = 175k. Costa 66/175 = 37.7%, closest to 38%. 34%, 43%, 47% are all at least 3.7 points away. (66/140 = 47% would be the trap using the 2024 total.)
